generatedBy: Captain, verifying FIX04's structural finding across every family rather than on the three that produced it
theFinding: The nine counters are built over the FILED packet's bytes. The document the participant actually reads to know what to do -- participant-instructions.md, and the guidance PDF where one is shipped -- is named by no artifact record anywhere, so no counter reads it.
foundBy: FIX04, on the three Indiana conviction families, in its own words: 'the guidance PDF is measured by nothing... it lives in the one delivered document no counter reads.'
whyThisIsTheHeadlineAndNotAFootnote: Nearly every participant-facing defect found today lives in that document, and every one was found by a lane reading it rather than by a counter: the guidance opening leaking packet-set ids and route keys; a trailing Route(s) line carrying bare obligation keys on 180 of 299 families; engineer roadmap directives printed to the participant on four separate pages; markdown tables arriving as raw pipes; Arkansas telling a participant to CHECK a caption that is entirely blank, in four places at once; Vermont handing a participant three blanks all reading 'Description of Offense'; Indiana printing 'READ THIS FIRST' engineer copy on page 1.
andWhyTheZeroesWereHonest: visualDefects: 0 was never a false statement about the guidance document. It is a byte-level glyph reading of the FILED packet, and the counters file says on its face that it is not a raster verdict. The counter did not lie; it was never asked. That is worse in one specific way -- an unasked question reads exactly like an answered one on a green row.
whatThisDoesNotMean: It does not mean the filed packets are unmeasured. They are measured hard, by nine counters and a central raster.
It does not mean any family's terminal status was granted on a false counter. The counters reported what they measured.
It does not, by itself, condemn any family. It says where the factory is not looking.
theRemedyIsNotObvious: Adding the participant document to the artifact records would make every counter read it, and most of the nine -- protectedWrites, incompleteRows, requiredOptionsMissing -- have no meaning against prose. The defects actually found in it are of a different kind: a claim contradicting a measured refusal, an internal identifier reaching a reader, a directive addressed to the wrong person, a label that names more than one blank. Two lanes have now built guards of exactly that shape for one family each, by hand. Whether that becomes a tenth counter, a separate gate, or a lane obligation is a design question and it is not mine to settle alone.
notFixedHere: Nothing is changed. This records where the factory does not look, at the commit it was measured.
grantsNothing: This records a measurement. It repairs nothing, promotes nothing and withdraws nothing.
